title: Reading a list of circuit children
statement: For a variable bound $n$, a fuel bound, and a Boolean list, the child-list reader returns either no result or a list of Boolean circuit trees together with the unused suffix. It fails with zero fuel or on malformed input; a leading false ends the list, while a leading true signals another circuit followed recursively by the remaining children.
